logbook.aquamirae.pirate_ship.content:
Entry #12

Last afternoon, Captain Cornelia went to the seabed in search of any additional resources. There are rumors among the crew that the real subject of her expedition is something else.

More than a day has passed since the captain's dive. She was wearing the only diving suit we had, so we couldn't help her in any way. Worst of all, she had the master key with her. As our hopes of rescue dwindle, the threat of rebellion grows.
logbook.aquamirae.pirate_outpost.content:
Entry #34

These beasts from the depths prowl for someone to devour... One of those critters has already eaten our midshipman... Swallowed him whole along with his crossbow.

Entry #35

We are waiting in vain for rescue... No one will come to help us, we have to survive on our own. Today the construction of the fort from parts of the ship was completed. In any case, she could no longer plow the seas ever again.

Entry #36

We are no longer able to heat the fort, resources are running out. Part of the crew began to dig a shelter underground. It is the only way we have a chance not to freeze to death.

Entry #37

We hid our supplies and valuable cargo underground. But Poseidon cursed us, and during the storm the lieutenant washed away into the sea... Along with master keys.

The hope remains that we could possibly find similar keys on other ships of our fleet, which have suffered the same fate as us.
logbook.aquamirae.pirate_shelter.content:
Entry #41

In these cursed lands there you can't find shelter even under the ice and the thickness of the earth... Some creatures that look like eels crawled out of the depths of the underworld, depriving us of the opportunity to return back to the surface.

Only the mistress of the moon knows how long shall we last... At all events, our hopes of seeing sunlight had all but vanished. This place will become our grave, our eternal tomb. For us and that damned rune...

Last Entry

It whispers to me, whispers inside my head the secrets of ice and snow... Ice... Now we are chained in ice forever...

I suppose a similar fate awaits the crew that set out in search of the fire rune... I wonder if they made it to the Great Dark Forest valley. Though it doesn't really matter now.

config.aquamirae.option.shell_horn_usage:
Controls where the Shell Horn can be used.

§fEVERYWHERE§7 – The Shell Horn can be used anywhere.

§fICE_MAZE§7 – The Shell Horn can only be used within the Ice Maze, regardless of dimension.

config.aquamirae.option.shell_horn_spawn: Vertical offset of Captain Cornelia's spawn position from the water surface.
config.aquamirae.option.shell_horn_summo: Delay between using the Shell Horn and spawning Captain Cornelia or reporting a failed summon.
config.aquamirae.option.shell_horn_coold: Cooldown between attempts to use the Shell Horn.

Defines which biomes or biome tags are treated as Ice Maze. Equivalent to modifying §f#aquamirae:ice_maze§7 tag via a datapack.
config.aquamirae.option.placement_spacin: The size of each structure placement region, measured in chunks. A new structure position is generated once per spacing × spacing region. Larger values result in fewer structures and greater distances between them.
config.aquamirae.option.placement_separa: Reduces the range of possible positions within each spacing region by this many chunks along each axis. Higher values move structures toward the beginning of each region.
config.aquamirae.option.biome_spawner_mo:
Controls how Aquamirae spawns are added to biomes tagged with aquamirae:ice_maze.

§fOVERRIDE§7 – Replaces all existing spawns with Aquamirae spawns.

§fMERGE§7 – Adds Aquamirae spawns while keeping existing spawns.

§fNONE§7 – Disables Aquamirae spawns entirely.
Whether this mob can spawn through the Aquamirae spawning system.
